character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
A friendly Korean countryside white dog with clean ivory-white short fur, a slightly cream-colored muzzle and ears, dark brown eyes and a black nose. Medium-small Korean mixed-breed dog with upright triangular ears, sturdy legs and a naturally curled fluffy tail. Friendly and gentle expression.

Rustic Korean rural village life-simulation game aesthetic. Charming clean pixel art, simple readable shapes, limited natural color palette, subtle pixel shading and crisp edges. Keep subtle light-gray and cream shading so the white fur remains clearly visible. Designed as a small NPC animal wandering around houses, farms and village roads. No collar, no accessories, no clothes.
